senses.gloss: , (h. form) דְּרָשָׁה f. (preced.) interpretation, argument, attempt to harmonize.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 62b:16">Pes. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>ת׳ גמלי דדרשה</he> (Ms. M. <he>דְּרָשֵׁי</he> pl., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note), v. <cite ref="A02881"><he>אָצֵל</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 54b:13">Yeb. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>לד׳ אתי</he> is required for an argument to be based upon it.
Ib. ומאי ד׳ and what is the argument based upon it? Ib. 70ᵇ בו לדרשה וכ׳ the word bo (Ex. XXII, 44, a. e.) is inserted for interpretation (emphasis); a. fr.
